Confirmed in working tree: apps/backend/app/engine/data_manager.py:3017,3032-3035.

anti_goal_violations.anti_goal: AG-3 (dimension): displayed numbers must be correct — a fetch that lands new bars silently blanks the DEFAULT /data coverage panel to false all-zeros.
anti_goal_violations.evidence: Audit Finding B1 + browser-qa 'Additional Finding' (both live-reproduced iter-2): a fetch that lands >=1 bar changed the dataset_version fingerprint, so no current-stamp coverage_snapshot row matched and the default as_of=None visit fell to the honest-empty all-zero sentinel for a fully-ingested DB until restart/backfill. RESOLVED iter-3: the B1 fix widens _run_job's finalize gate with a new elif firing for successful fetch/expand, calling the canonical refresh_coverage_snapshot (no second derivation) gated by _coverage_snapshot_is_current so a zero-work fetch pays nothing. Independently verified by the audit code-trace + 6 new unit tests + live J-03-verify.png showing /data serving real non-zero coverage (540/591/5380/762).
